title: LULC Change Detection & Carbon Stock Estimation — Lahore District, Pakistan
description: Google Earth Engine pipeline for multi-year (1993–2023) LULC classification using Random Forest and carbon stock estimation aligned with InVEST Carbon Model logic. Underlying data for the submitted manuscript on urban expansion and ecosystem carbon loss in Lahore.
highlights: ~3.15 million metric tons of estimated carbon loss

title: Layyah District Flood Monitor
description: Web-based flood monitoring tool combining a FastAPI backend and an Earth Engine pipeline: Sentinel-1 SAR flood-extent detection against a permanent water mask, restricted to the river floodplain buffer, with a Leaflet map front end.
highlights: Dual-polarisation (VV + VH) SAR thresholding for flood detection
Floodplain-buffer restriction cut false positives from ~1,600 to ~116 patches
Live Leaflet map with district boundary, river, and on-demand flood layer
